notes.content:
Here I am, and I have something to tell you, about Unfinished, like what's gonna happen or anything.


[b]Developer Name Change[/b]
As you know, I'm Andrew Studio 2.0, but for reasons I changed my name into AndrewGames. But in Unfinished and Unfinished 2 in the Credits is staying the Andrew Studio 2.0

[b]Unfinished: PlayMare Handbook[/b]
This is gonna be a book, what is tells the lore behind Unfinished and Unfinished 2, it's gonna be happen, I promise.

[b]Unfinished 3[/b]
Well I do it, I'm gonna make Unfinished 3, and I know my mind is changing very fast, but I have a lot of Ideas for the third installment of Unfinished.

Stay tooned and please know, that I gonna work on this, Goodbye.

notes.title: UNCANCELING UNFINISHED 3!
notes.content:
YEAH! I'm actually Uncanceling Unfinished 3. BUT with a Different Idea, Different Characters, Different Story, BUT! Here is some changes what I make for Unfinished 3.

[b]Change the title[/b]
I change the title to simply just to Unfinished 3. That's 'cause School of Pin is no more existing in the story.

[b]Deleting Kro[/b]
Yeah, I'm actually Deleting Kro from the game, sorry fans, this is my vision, and I make how I want this to be, sorry but he is got replaced with a Three head dragon, I don't know why.

[b]The Serial Killer comes back, but he is gonna be distrubing and digusting[/b]
Yeah, the Serial Killer from Unfinshed 2 is come back, but one point in the story he is gonna be disgusting and disturbing.

Heres my Plans for The Unfinished Franchise

[olist]
[*] Make Unfinished 3 as a videogame
[*] Adapting Unfinished and Unfinished 2 to an eBook
[*] Make a three part Unfinished eBook series
[*] Adapting Unfinished 3 to a eBook
[/olist]

These are my plans for the Unfinished Franchise, have a good day, and don't Forget, I have an Idea for Unfinished 3!

notes.title: News For Unfinished 3
notes.content:
[b]UNFINISHED 3[/b] is having news, but not big news. hehe.

[b]Changing Back The perspective[/b]
The Perspective is Changing back, to 2D Top-Down, And I Have a Reason for that, That's Because I Was Wrote the STORY, and it's too complex to me to make it in 3D.

[b]The Story[/b]
So I wrote the Story and it's Drama, Action, and Horror, and a little bit of cliffhanger ending.
I Can't tell you the story Because, It's Gonna be Spoiler a Very Very big Spoiler.

[b]The Monsters are'nt appear[/b]
The Monsters from Unfinished 1 and 2 is not gonna be appear. Why? I will tell you Why.
The Story is can be a game of the Unfinished series without the monsters... I Don't Know why



So yeah, This game is a little bit of a Downgrade but not too much. Goodbye.

notes.title: Big News for School of Pin!
notes.content:
[b]SCHOOL OF PIN[/b] is having big news!

[b]TITLE[/b]
The Title is changed because my final Idea is continues the story of Unfinished...
So the new title is "Unfinished 3: The School of Pin" Yeah, I know I was like Annouced this game like a different line game (I mean it's Takes place in the same universe than Unfinished but in a different line). But! Now it's gonna be a continue of the Line of Unfinished!

[b]New Protagonist[/b]
Everyone is played the first two games with Lora, but Now in the story it's been 12 Years after Unfinished 2. So now the Progtagonist is Liza, The Daughter of Lora.

[b]New Perspective[/b]
As you know the first two games is a 2D Top-Down game... BUT Unfinished 3 is gonna be Different Because is a 3D FIRST PERSON! Yeah, it's New! Ahh....

[b]New Antagonist[/b]
Okay, Unfinished 3 is gonna be having not one but two antagonist. The First one is Kro, a 4000 Years Old Evil... Demon Like creature. The Second one is Devil who is the serial killer from Unfinished 2 but he is now in a Devil Costume.

[b]Graphics[/b]
So... Graphics uhm... I want Unfinished 3 to be a Realistic, And Not Pixel art. That Means I need to Choose a Realistic Game Engine... Not Like Unfinished 1 and 2 Which is not made in a Realistic Game Engine.

[b]School of Pin like a location[/b]
School of Pin is gonna be a Location where the main events are happening. That Means The School is like   99% of the Story.


These are my Plans for Unfinished 3, I hope You guys are waiting for it... Goodbye.
